Introduction

Duna is a South Korean singer and dancer under A2Z Entertainment. She is the current leader of the girl group CSR.

In December 2023, Duna was revealed to be a contestant on WeTV's survival show "Chuang Asia" alongside fellow CSR members Seoyeon, Geumhee and Yeham.
